blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Shower Repair
blocks.body: A cartridge or seal replacement is usually quick. Multi-head showers, thermostatic valves and steam units take more time to diagnose and repair. Working behind stone or tile adds labor. We diagnose first and quote a flat price.

items.answer: Yes, we service the water supply, drain and generator connections. Electrical or control board issues may need the manufacturer's service.

items.q: Can you fix a leak without removing tile?
items.answer: Usually. Most valve repairs go through the trim. Leaks in the pan or behind the tile may need more.

items.q: Why does my shower turn hot when someone runs water elsewhere?
items.answer: The pressure-balancing or thermostatic cartridge is worn. Replacing it usually solves it.

items.q: Can you replace an old shower valve during a remodel?
items.answer: Yes. We install new valves, diverters and body spray lines as part of a remodel.

items.q: Why is there a stain on the ceiling under our shower?
items.preview: A leak at the valve, drain or pan.
items.answer: A leak at the valve, the drain or the shower pan. We test each one before anything is opened.

items.q: Can you install a steam shower?
items.answer: We handle the water supply and drain. The generator and enclosure come from the shower supplier.

items.q: Can you add body sprays to my shower?
items.answer: Often, if the supply and valve can handle the extra flow.
